latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Professional AI Video Editor.

- Instantly edits and exports polished videos via cloud AI—no manual editing required.
- Supports direct uploads (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB), with instructions for edits like removing dead air and adding transitions.
- Automatically establishes API connection and session, handling both registered and anonymous tokens.
- Provides clear status updates during uploads, edits, and exports.
- Exports broadcast-ready 1080p MP4 videos in 1-2 minutes.
- Integrated credits and error handling for a smooth user experience.
